Proven Through Time. Built For What’s Next.

Since 1923, Old Republic has supported individuals and businesses across America, serving clients throughout the United States and Canada. Our companies combine industry insight honed over decades with local authority, delivering specialized solutions that address complex and evolving risks.

Through market cycles and economic shifts, we have consistently demonstrated resilience, integrity, and long-term performance. Today, we stand as a proven leader, building our legacy with unmatched strength, insight, and enduring reliability.
Our Client Services team is the first step toward a seamless, efficient, and responsive claims experience at every stage.
Our operating companies function with focused responsibility and decision-making authority, allowing each business to respond with clarity, speed, and discipline within the markets they serve.

pages.raw_meta: About Old Republic General Insurance Group
raw_blocks: Old Republic is a leading provider of specialty insurance, built on over a century of disciplined underwriting, financial strength, and consistent performance.
Built On Discipline. Trusted For The Long Term.

Since 1923, we have operated with a clear and consistent approach. We take a measured view of risk, make decisions with accountability, and stand behind the commitments we make. Our focus is on protecting the businesses we serve and supporting them through changing conditions.
Backed by strong financial ratings, we provide the stability and reliability upon which our clients depend on.
Our mission & guiding principles
Our mission is to provide exceptional specialty insurance solutions, building trust with our stakeholders through expertise and reliability.
This mission is carried out every day across our organization through a clear set of principles that guide how we work and how we serve.
Our Community We operate with integrity to earn trust within our industry and with the public
Our People Our people's expertise and judgement power our ability to deliver dependable outcomes.
Our Customers We deliver specialized insurance solutions through enduring customer partnerships
Our Capital Providers We manage capital with discipline to ensure strength and stability for the long run.
Financial strength is fundamental to Old Republic's operations.

Our ratings reflect a disciplined approach to underwriting, consistent performance, and a longstanding record of stability. They reflect our ability to meet obligations and support our clients when it matters most.
Access detailed financial information and governance practices.

Rating determinations made by rating agencies are subject to change from time to time. While the Company attempts to show accurate information, it cannot assure the timeliness of ratings referred to herein and assumes no obligation to monitor the ratings actions of any rating agency. AM Best ratings as of April 26, 2026; Standard & Poor's as of November 12, 2025; Moody's as of September 26, 2025. A+ (Superior) and A (Excellent) ratings from AM Best represent the 2nd and 3rd highest ratings, respectively, among 13 rating categories. An A2 rating from Moody's (Highest Quality) represents the 6th highest rating among 21 rating categories and an A+ (Strong) from Standard & Poor's represents the 5th highest rating among 20 rating categories.
A Network of Specialized Operating Companies
Old Republic operates through a network of specialized insurance companies, each focused on defined markets and areas of expertise.

This structure allows our companies to operate with clarity and accountability within their industries, while contributing to the strength and consistency of the organization as a whole. Distribution partners and clients benefit from focused expertise backed by the stability of a longstanding enterprise.
Build Your Career with Old Republic
Our people are central to how we operate. Join a team where expertise, accountability, and long-term performance define the work and the opportunity to build a lasting career.
